name: Ambitious Impact
summary: Formerly Charity Entrepreneurship, a UK charity that researches intervention ideas and runs an incubation programme to found new charities to carry out the best of them (60+ launched since 2018, among them Fortify Health, Suvita, Family Empowerment Media, LEEP, Shrimp Welfare Project and Ansh), with seed grants it raises and passes on. Smaller programmes train founders of for-profit companies who pledge to give (Founding to Give), grantmakers and researchers, run funding circles and launched five effective giving organisations. It is also an evaluator on this site: its idea reports' cost-effectiveness analyses are its own models.

spending.source: https://opencharities.uk/ew/1195850/files/2025-03-31-accounts.md (Charity Entrepreneurship, charity 1195850, audited accounts for the year to 31 March 2025, Moore Kingston Smith LLP: charitable activities £3,953,275, raising funds nil; of it, grants payable to incubated organisations £1,969,975 (note 4), donors' money passed on to the new charities and counted in their own spending, and support and governance £591,846 (note 3). Programme here: the direct costs of its programmes less the grants passed on, £1,391,454, at the IRS 2024 average of $1.277 per pound. No split by programme is published.)

lines.label: Research and incubation of new charities, effective giving organisations and Founding to Give companies; funding circles; grantmaker and research training
lines.source: https://opencharities.uk/ew/1195850/files/2025-03-31-accounts.md (note 3, p. 39: charitable activities by cost type only, staff £1,000,601, programme costs £488,113 and others; the trustees' report gives staff time as research ~20%, recruitment ~23%, programmes ~45%, operations ~12%. One line because one model covers every programme, as branches.)
